tool.name: LMSYS Chatbot Arena Conversations
tool.summary: Open dataset of over 1 million real-world pairwise prompt conversations and human preference votes collected from the LMSYS Chatbot Arena.
tool.architecture: Crowdsourced human side-by-side preference votes with model identities revealed post-vote.
tool.usage:
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("lmsys/chatbot_arena_conversations", split="train")
tool.benchmarks: Industry standard for calculating ELO ratings of frontier LLMs.
tool.limitations: Subject to prompt distribution biases of Arena visitors.
